ui.title: Workspace Restore
ui.intro: Each workspace keeps a list of apps. Restoring opens the ones that aren't open and moves the rest back. Nothing gets closed.
ui.restore-all-tooltip: Put every workspace back on its screen and move its apps there. Nothing gets closed.
ui.restore-all-tooltip-open: Put every workspace back on its screen and move its apps there. This also opens: {apps}. Nothing gets closed.
ui.restore-now-tooltip: Put this workspace back on its screen and move its apps there, opening any that aren't open. Nothing gets closed.
ui.add-app-tooltip: Pick an open window or an installed app to add to this workspace
ui.remove: Remove from this workspace's list (the app keeps running)
ui.not-open-tooltip: Not open right now. Restoring opens it.
ui.at-login-tooltip: Restore this workspace automatically when you log in. Click to switch on or off.
ui.auto-add-tooltip: When you open an app on this workspace that isn't saved anywhere yet, add it to this list. It never removes anything. Click to switch on or off.
ui.keyword-tooltip: Restoring puts the {app} window whose title contains this word here. Press Enter to save.
ui.edit-failed: Couldn't change the list. It may have just changed; try again.
ui.search: Search open windows and installed apps
ui.open-windows-hint: Most reliable: remembers the exact command, browser profile or terminal command.
ui.installed-apps-hint: For apps that aren't open right now. Started from their app menu entry.

add-all-open.one: Add the window open on this workspace
add-all-open.other: Add all {count} windows open on this workspace

ui.add-again-tooltip: Already on this workspace's list. Add it again only if you use a second window of this app here.
ui.open-not-listed: Open here, not on the list:
ui.twice-here: {app} is on this list twice. If that's a mistake, remove one with ×.
ui.keyword-ask: To tell the windows apart, type a word from this window's title:
ui.listed-tooltip: This window is open on this workspace and already on its list
ui.already-listed: That window is already on this workspace's list.
ui.in-place-tooltip: Every app on this list is open here and the workspace is on its screen, so restoring would change nothing
ui.all-in-place-tooltip: Every workspace is already in place
